title: Soil Testing
description: Regular soil testing helps determine nutrient levels and soil health

parameters.name: pH
parameters.correction: Add lime for acidic soil, sulfur for alkaline soil

parameters.name: Organic Matter
parameters.importance: Improves soil structure and water holding capacity
parameters.correction: Add FYM, compost, or farm waste

parameters.name: Nitrogen (N)
parameters.importance: Essential for leaf and stem growth
parameters.correction: Apply nitrogen fertilizers or legume crops

parameters.name: Phosphorus (P)
parameters.importance: Critical for root development and flowering
parameters.correction: Apply phosphatic fertilizers or bone meal

parameters.name: Potassium (K)
parameters.importance: Improves drought resistance and disease tolerance
parameters.correction: Apply potassium fertilizers or wood ash

tips: Get soil samples from 5-6 spots in field, mix well, and send 500g sample to lab

title: Soil Conservation
description: Practices to maintain and improve soil health

methods.name: Crop Rotation
methods.benefit: Reduces pest build-up, improves nitrogen fixation
methods.practice: Rotate cereal-legume crops in 2-3 year cycle

methods.name: Mulching
methods.benefit: Reduces soil erosion, conserves moisture, controls weeds
methods.practice: Use straw, leaves, or plastic mulch around plants

methods.name: Contour Ploughing
methods.practice: Plough along contour lines instead of up-down slopes

methods.name: Composting
methods.benefit: Adds organic matter and improves soil structure
methods.practice: Mix farm waste, dung, and green manure in pit

methods.name: Green Manuring
methods.benefit: Adds nitrogen to soil, improves organic matter
methods.practice: Grow legume crops and plow them back

title: Soil Types and Characteristics
description: Understanding different soil types helps in crop selection

types.name: Loamy Soil
types.characteristics: Ideal for most crops, good drainage, fertile

types.name: Sandy Soil
types.characteristics: Quick drainage, less fertile, requires more irrigation

nutrients.name: Iron (Fe)
nutrients.deficiencySymptoms: Yellowing of young leaves with green veins

nutrients.name: Boron (B)
nutrients.deficiencySymptoms: Distorted leaves, hollow stems, poor flower formation

nutrients.name: Copper (Cu)
nutrients.deficiencySymptoms: Wilting of leaves, loss of color
